notice: Demo schematic renderings of Pakistan-style signage (left-hand traffic). Shapes/colours follow the regional convention: octagon=stop, inverted triangle=warning, red ring=prohibition, blue=mandatory/information, green=direction.

signs.name: STOP
signs.rule: Stop behind the line, yield to traffic and pedestrians, proceed only when safe.

signs.name: Give Way
signs.meaning: Yield to traffic on the major road.
signs.rule: Slow, give priority, do not enter until it is safe.

signs.name: No Entry
signs.rule: Do not enter — one-way traffic flows the other way.

signs.name: Speed limit 40
signs.rule: Common near markets, schools and dense streets.

signs.name: Speed limit 60
signs.rule: Typical urban arterial limit.

signs.name: No Overtaking
signs.rule: Applies until a cancellation sign — usually on blind or narrow stretches.

signs.name: No Horn
signs.rule: Do not sound the horn — common near hospitals and schools.

signs.name: No Parking
signs.rule: Stopping briefly may be allowed; leaving the vehicle is not.

signs.name: No Stopping (clearway)
signs.rule: Stricter than no-parking: not even briefly.

signs.name: No U-Turn
signs.rule: Continue to the next gap or interchange.

signs.name: No Pedestrians
signs.rule: Applies on motorways and fast corridors.

signs.name: No Heavy Vehicles
signs.rule: Applies to goods vehicles above the posted weight.

signs.name: Keep Left
signs.meaning: Mandatory — pass to the left of the obstacle/island.
signs.rule: Pakistan drives on the left; the blue circle enforces it.

signs.name: Turn Right Only
signs.rule: All traffic must turn in the arrow's direction.

signs.name: Roundabout Ahead (mandatory)
signs.rule: Yield to traffic already on the roundabout from your right.

signs.name: One-Way Street
signs.rule: Follow the arrow direction; no turning against it.

signs.name: Pedestrian Crossing Ahead
signs.meaning: Crossing ahead — people may step out.
signs.rule: Slow, be ready to stop, never overtake near it.

signs.name: School Zone
signs.rule: Reduce speed well below the limit; no overtaking.

signs.name: Cattle Crossing
signs.meaning: Animals on or near the road.
signs.rule: Slow down and pass wide — animals move unpredictably.

signs.name: Slippery Road
signs.rule: Ease off, avoid sudden braking or steering.

signs.name: Road Narrows
signs.rule: Reduce speed; merge politely with oncoming traffic.

signs.name: Traffic Signals Ahead
signs.rule: Be prepared to stop behind the line.

signs.name: Roundabout Ahead
signs.rule: Slow, keep left, yield to the right before entering.

signs.name: Falling Rocks
signs.rule: Do not stop under the slope; watch the road surface.

signs.name: Steep Hill
signs.rule: Use low gear; never ride the brakes downhill.

signs.name: Two-Way Traffic
signs.meaning: Single carriageway ends — oncoming flow ahead.
signs.rule: Keep well left; overtaking needs full visibility.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.rule: No horn in this zone; expect pedestrians.

signs.name: First Aid
signs.rule: Information sign — know your route services.

signs.name: Fuel Station
signs.rule: Slow in and out; watch queues spilling onto the road.

signs.name: Parking
signs.rule: Use it instead of stopping on the road.

signs.name: Bus Stop
signs.rule: Expect buses pulling out — do not overtake on its left.

signs.name: Motorway Begin
signs.rule: Min 60 / max 120 km/h for cars; pedestrians and learners banned.

signs.name: Direction / Distance
signs.rule: Plan your lane early — late cuts cause crashes.
